output.one_liner: Slack is a channel-based messaging platform for team communication, collaboration, and application integration.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow. Apps request scopes during installation. Both bot and user scopes supported.

evidence.snippet: Slack apps are installed with a v2 OAuth 2.0 flow.

access.notes: Free Developer Program sandbox available to all developers. Basic features free; additional enterprise features available with optional payment method (not charged).

evidence.snippet: A developer sandbox can be used to build against all Slack features safely and securely, without an additional cost.
Every developer enrolled in the Slack Developer Program is eligible to provision a basic sandbox.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: Most methods allow at least 20 requests per minute with burst tolerance. Rates vary by tier and method.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free OAuth2 credentials via Developer Program sandbox, extensively documented broad REST API, official MCP server, and existing Composio toolkit confirm buildability.
